title: 10-Year TIPS auction (NEW ISSUE) — the first real-yield primary print of 2027, and the only venue a TIPS size change has ever expressed
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by this event's own initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised. The row reads verbatim `10-Year  TIPST / Thursday, January 14, 2027 / Thursday, January 21, 2027 / Friday, January 29, 2027`. The same PDF carries its own legend, also read verbatim this session: `T --denotes TIPS` and `R --denotes reopening` — so the ABSENCE of an `R` here is Treasury's own marker for a NEW ISSUE, not an inference of ours. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. The CUSIP does not exist yet and is not guessed. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), which read `proposals/treasury-10y-tips-2027-01-21.from-treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.json` in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md — the only proposal for this id. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-10y-tips-2027-01-21.md. THE PROPOSAL'S SIZE EXPECTATION IS AMENDED, NOT INHERITED. It recorded '$21B is the base case' from a flat three-new-issue run. Re-pulling fiscaldata `auctions_query` with `inflation_index_security: Yes` back to 2018-01-01 (105 rows, 52 on the 10-Year leg, 18 new issues) finds the 10-Year TIPS new-issue size has NEVER stayed flat for four consecutive new issues: the runs are 13Bx3, 14Bx3, 15Bx1, 16Bx2, 17Bx3, 18Bx1, 19Bx1, 20Bx1 and now 21Bx3 (2025-07-24, 2026-01-22, 2026-07-23) — every one of the three prior runs that reached three was ended by a step-up at the fourth, 3 of 3. So this auction is the first test of a fourth. THE COUNTERWEIGHT IS STRONGER AND IS WHY $21B REMAINS THE BASE CASE: the cap-at-three is a 10-Year-series artifact with n=3, and the same TIPS complex holds two live counterexamples — the 5-Year ran FOUR consecutive at $17B (2019-04 to 2020-10) and the 30-Year has run SIX consecutive at $9B (2021-02 to 2026-02, still running). Meanwhile 2026 is the first year since 2020 in which NO TIPS tenor's new issue rose at all (0 of 4 transitions: 30Y 2026-02 $9B, 10Y 2026-01 $21B, 5Y 2026-04 $26B, 10Y 2026-07 $21B), against 4 of 5 in 2025. THE CHEAPEST LIVE TEST LANDS 91 DAYS EARLY: `treasury-5y-tips-2026-10-22` is itself a NEW ISSUE, so a $27B print there says the TIPS freeze broke and re-weights January toward $22B; $26B says it held. THE JANUARY DEMAND ASYMMETRY, this doc's own finding and previously unmeasured on this calendar: the January 10-Year TIPS new issue has out-covered its OWN year's July new issue 9 of 9 years since 2018 (mean +0.186 bid-to-cover, range +0.07 to +0.47, never once negative). It survives a size control — in the four years the two auctions were the same size (2018, 2020, 2023, 2026) January still won 4 of 4, mean +0.23 — and it is NOT a general Treasury or TIPS seasonal: the nominal 10-Year Feb-vs-Aug control is 6/9 mean +0.034 and the 5-Year TIPS Apr-vs-Oct control is 4/7 mean +0.023, both noise. The obvious mechanism FAILS: indirect-bidder share is higher in January in only 6 of 9 years, so the cause is unidentified and the finding is a base rate, not an explanation. POLICY-LOADED, NOT POLICY-CLEAN — the inversion of the sibling treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19's frame: this auction prices INSIDE the FOMC blackout (fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, five days earlier) and D-6 to fomc-2027-01-27, so it is the pair's contaminated print, not its clean one. THE WEEK IS FOUR SESSIONS: mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 shifts the whole bill slate to Tuesday 01-19, a 20-Year BOND reopening auctions D-1 on 2027-01-20, and Treasury announces the entire month-end coupon block (2Y note, 5Y note, 2Y FRN, 7Y note, plus 13/26/6-week bills) the MORNING OF this auction — the same shared-session structure the 11-19 sibling measured, recurring. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
